name: Perospirone
summary: Perospirone (Lullan) is an atypical antipsychotic of the azapirone family. It was introduced in Japan by Dainippon Sumitomo Pharma in 2001 for the treatment of schizophrenia and acute cases of bipolar mania.

uses.text: It was introduced in Japan by Dainippon Sumitomo Pharma in 2001 for the treatment of schizophrenia and acute cases of bipolar mania.

sideEffects.text: Has a higher incidence of extrapyramidal side effects than the other atypical antipsychotics, but still less than that seen with typical antipsychotics. A trend was observed in a clinical trial comparing mosapramine with perospirone that favoured perospirone for producing less prominent extrapyramidal side effects than mosapramine although statistical significant was not reached.

summaryZh: 哌羅匹隆（英語：Perospirone），商品名有Lullan、康爾汀，是 2001 年由大日本住友製藥在日本推出的非典型抗精神病藥，主要用於治療精神分裂症以及雙相情感障礙。

pharmacology.en: It blocks dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2A receptors and acts as a partial agonist at the 5-HT1A receptor, a combination typical of the newer antipsychotics.
pharmacology.zh: 它阻斷多巴胺 D2 與血清素 5-HT2A 受體，並在 5-HT1A 受體上作為部分促效劑，這種組合是較新一代抗精神病藥的典型特徵。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它阻断多巴胺 D2 与血清素 5-HT2A 受体，并在 5-HT1A 受体上作为部分促效剂，这种组合是较新一代抗精神病药的典型特征。

fact.en: It belongs to the azapirones, the same family as the anti-anxiety drug buspirone, and has been sold in Japan since 2001.
fact.zh: 它屬於阿扎吡酮類，與抗焦慮藥丁螺環酮同一家族，自 2001 年起在日本販售。
fact.zhHans: 它属于阿扎吡酮类，与抗焦虑药丁螺环酮同一家族，自 2001 年起在日本贩售。
